items.text: Color, the right way up. The drawer shows only your current colors, one swatch per group, and a mixer button at the end; tap a group to select it and the shelf below slides to its colors, the current one lit; tap a color to set it. Hold a group for the Color mixer; the mixer button opens it at the selected group
the Color mixer is as wide as the bar and lays its controls in two columns on a wide screen
the (i) in a panel's band sits at the right, beside ‹ › ⌄

Tools' shelf (drag down on ⋯) is a strip of things to tap for the tool in use. No tool: the tools themselves. Color: every group's choices (the drawer above shows your current colors: tap one to jump to its choices, hold it for the Color mixer). Text: your words, the ones in the sequence dancing. View: Clean, Arrows, Blueprint, Glow, Grain. Pattern: the patterns, which change only the pattern and keep your colors and sound. Steer and magnet: your recorded loops (tap to play or stop, hold to remove). Frame: Fit, Fill, Center, Turn 90°
with the camera as the source, what you capture is kept in your library too, as the camera saw it: a still keeps the frame, a video or a GIF keeps the camera's clip. Find them in Source's shelf
with a surf or sea bed playing, the beat is heard again, so the music sets off the water's voices as it should

the Field panel, in Tools (the last tile, field): reach, strength, particles, trail fade, lifespan and wobble, with five presets (Calm, Silk, Storm, Dust, Long trails). It comes with Pro: everyone can open it and look; with a key it works

in the color panel the speed slider stays in its place when the animation is off (greyed), so choosing Pulse no longer moves everything. The same for "every" in two-color timing, the bytebeat's back button and the card's QR choice

two water presets with animals. Harbor: surf on the wall, drops, and gulls overhead (tap high on the screen, above the waterline, for a gull; the gulls are in the air, so the water never muffles them). Pod: open sea and porpoises clicking past, sometimes whistling (a tap is a click train, and it breaks the water surface)
every panel above the bar is exactly as wide as the bar, and ‹ › ⌄ sit in the same corner of every panel, so stepping between panels never moves them
on a wide screen the lists (scenes, the random matrix, the mixer, your texts) sit in two columns
scene links work again (0.29.3 could not make them)
scene links and the cards' QR codes are works.chamy.xyz/c/ links now. The links you already sent keep working
